name: Hawke’s Bay Region GIS Forum
story: Council practitioners used the Hawke’s Bay forum to discuss GIS work and professional events. In September 2008, Darrel Hall summarised their views on the future of GIS conferences. He described a regional mix of MapInfo, GenaMap and Esri users and discussed the cost and value of attending national events.

sources.label: NZEUG GISList discussion, The future of the NZ ESRI User Group Conference, including council and Hawke's Bay regional responses
